title: Pluto
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Europol robot detective Gesicht investigates murders of robots and humans whose bodies are marked with horn-like objects. The seven most advanced robots in the world, potential weapons of mass destruction, all appear to be targets, and the trail leads back to a war.
life_message: A good life means choosing to stop the cycle of hatred, even when you have reason to hate.
